t: 瓦斯科·达伽马的舰队访问莫桑比克岛。
te: Vasco da Gama's fleet visits the Island of Mozambique.
dz: 瓦斯科·达伽马的舰队访问莫桑比克岛。
de: Vasco da Gama's fleet visits the Island of Mozambique.

t: 葡萄牙探险家瓦斯科·达·伽马抵达印度科泽科德（以前称为卡利卡特）时发现了通往印度的海路。
te: Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama discovers the sea route to India when he arrives at Kozhikode (previously known as Ca…
dz: 葡萄牙探险家瓦斯科·达·伽马抵达印度科泽科德（以前称为卡利卡特）时发现了通往印度的海路。
de: Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama discovers the sea route to India when he arrives at Kozhikode (previously known as Calicut), India.

t: 吉罗拉莫·萨沃纳罗拉被烧在意大利佛罗伦萨的木桩上.
te: Girolamo Savonarola is burned at the stake in Florence, Italy.
dz: 吉罗拉莫·萨沃纳罗拉被烧在意大利佛罗伦萨的木桩上.
de: Girolamo Savonarola is burned at the stake in Florence, Italy.

t: 在第三次西半球航行中，克里斯托弗·哥伦布成为第一个发现特立尼达岛的欧洲人。
te: On his third voyage to the Western Hemisphere, Christopher Columbus becomes the first European to discover the island o…
dz: 在第三次西半球航行中，克里斯托弗·哥伦布成为第一个发现特立尼达岛的欧洲人。
de: On his third voyage to the Western Hemisphere, Christopher Columbus becomes the first European to discover the island of Trinidad.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布成为第一个访问现在的委内瑞拉的欧洲人。
te: Christopher Columbus becomes the first European to visit what is now Venezuela.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布成为第一个访问现在的委内瑞拉的欧洲人。
de: Christopher Columbus becomes the first European to visit what is now Venezuela.

t: 教宗亚历山大六世之子塞萨雷·博尔吉亚成为历史上第一个辞去主教职位的人;同日晚些时候,法国国王路…
te: Cesare Borgia, son of Pope Alexander VI, becomes the first person in history to resign the cardinalate; later that same…
dz: 教宗亚历山大六世之子塞萨雷·博尔吉亚成为历史上第一个辞去主教职位的人;同日晚些时候,法国国王路易十二任命他为瓦伦蒂诺瓦公爵.
de: Cesare Borgia, son of Pope Alexander VI, becomes the first person in history to resign the cardinalate; later that same day, King Louis XII of France names him Duke of Valentinois.

t: 瓦斯科·达伽马决定离开卡利卡特返回葡萄牙王国。
te: Vasco da Gama decides to depart Calicut and return to the Kingdom of Portugal.
dz: 瓦斯科·达伽马决定离开卡利卡特返回葡萄牙王国。
de: Vasco da Gama decides to depart Calicut and return to the Kingdom of Portugal.

t: 南开海啸将大活佛位于Kōtoku-in的建筑物冲走;此后一直被置于外.
te: The Nankai tsunami washes away the building housing the Great Buddha at Kōtoku-in; it has been located outside ever sin…
dz: 南开海啸将大活佛位于Kōtoku-in的建筑物冲走;此后一直被置于外.
de: The Nankai tsunami washes away the building housing the Great Buddha at Kōtoku-in; it has been located outside ever since.
